note: Manufacturer (not a trader) of AC generators and motors up to 200 MW; industry_claimed 'Нефтегаз и химия' is only one of several end-markets (oil & gas, marine, railway, sugar, steel, thermal, renewables) — not a mismatch worth acting on. Declared HS codes 850164 (AC generators >750 kVA), 850239, 850300 (generator parts) fit the product line; 392690 (plastic articles) is likely packaging and is not a basis for rejection under Rule 3. Export status is declared_only strictly because no free customs/B-L row with date, destination and B/L number was obtainable — the 80% export order-inflow share and 100+ country claim are company/filing statements, not shipment records; this is a data-access limitation, not evidence of absence. Domestic supply is confirmed by audited revenue and a named traction-motor contract. Revenue: Rs 1,856 Cr FY Mar 2026 (consolidated), TTM Rs 2,513 Cr.
